best_for: Windows users who want a small, no-nonsense media player that handles modern codecs and subtitles, and who are happy with a mature app that is no longer adding features.

points.title: A fork that keeps it alive
points.text: This is the clsid2 fork of MPC-HC, maintained by its current developer since 2017. It is free under GPL v3.

points.title: Feature-complete by design
points.text: The maintainer calls the player mature and does not take new feature requests. Bug fixes and codec updates continue, and pull requests are welcome.

points.title: Codecs and HDR included
points.text: Decoding comes from the bundled LAV Filters, which covers HEVC, VVC and AV1. MPC Video Renderer is included; HDR playback needs it or madVR.

points.title: Strong subtitle support
points.text: Subtitles render faster than before, with libass and WebVTT support. Press D to search for subtitles online, or turn on automatic search.

points.title: Web videos with yt-dlp
points.text: Put yt-dlp.exe in the install folder to open videos from websites. The project suggests adding ffmpeg for the best quality.

points.title: Small comforts
points.text: There is a dark or light modern theme, adjustable speed, resume from where you stopped and A-B repeat.

points.title: Windows only
points.text: It runs on Windows 7 through 11, with machine-wide installers for 32-bit and 64-bit. There is no Mac or Linux build. The listing keeps 64 versions.
